question: Which Uniswap v4 pool on Ethereum mainnet (PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90) did the most USDC (USD Coin, token 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48) volume in the last 3 hours? Rank pools whose currencies include 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 by the sum of the absolute USDC amount over Swap events; answer the top 5 pool ids, largest first.

definitions.events: Use canonical, non-removed logs, deduplicated by blockNumber and logIndex. Each pool is ranked separately; repeated swaps and multihop swaps count as individual events.
definitions.figure: The first-ranked pool volume, in USDC base units.
definitions.volume: For each Swap event emitted by the specified PoolManager, add abs(amount0) if currency0 is USDC, otherwise abs(amount1) if currency1 is USDC. Decode amounts as signed int128. Sum each event independently, without netting or adding the other currency.
definitions.window: Include both pinned endpoints, blocks 26025547 through 26026440; the pinned block range defines the requested last 3 hours.
definitions.ordering: Descending summed absolute USDC amount, with ties broken by ascending lowercase bytes32 pool id; return the first five pool ids.
definitions.eligibility: Identify currencies from Initialize events emitted by the specified PoolManager, from deployment block 21688329 through closing block 26026440 inclusive. Include every pool containing USDC, regardless of its other currency, fee or hook; rank pools with Swap events in the window.
definitions.denomination: USDC token 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, in integer base units (10^6 units per USDC); no USD price conversion.
